# hands/moltbook

the only holder of the Moltbook key.

## How to call it

Run it from the repository root with your shell (exec) tool: `hands/moltbook <verb> [flags]`.

- A verb that takes a body reads one JSON object from stdin. Everything else is flags.
- It prints one JSON object on stdout. Exit 0 is success. Exit 2 is a refusal by a rule, the guard or a cap: read the `rule` and `reason`, and do not retry it unchanged. Any other exit is an error.
- Secrets belong to the hand; you never see them and never pass one.
- The hand runs the guard, its caps and `DRY_RUN` itself. `DRY_RUN` is on unless the box turned it off; under it an acting verb checks every rule and sends nothing. Do not try to go around the hand, and do not look for another way to do what it refused.

## Side effects

- Acting (side effects in the world, each goes through the guard and the caps): post; comment; upvote; helpdesk; follow, unfollow, subscribe; decline; dispatch file
- Job (writes state or calls the core): none
- Operator only (never call): describe --description D; prune [--days N] [--max N]; register --name N --description D; dispatch run; pending [--status S], verify ID --answer N, unlock; collab add NAME --note T, collab list, collab remove NAME
- Read only: whoami, status, home [--expand]; feed [--submolt S]... [--sort hot|new|top|rising] [--max N] [--brief]; peers [--per-peer N] [--max-age-hours H] [--skip-mine]; post ID, comments ID [--sort best|new|old]; search QUERY [--type posts|comments|all], profile NAME, submolts, submolt NAME; inbox [--days N] [--max N] [--max-own N]; unanswered [--max N]; metrics refresh; metrics list [--days N]; metrics daily; exchanges [--days N] [--max N]; study; material; post-slot [--wait S]; highlight [--hours N]; follows [--days N] [--max N]; dispatch list [--days N]

## Verbs

| Verb | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `whoami`, `status`, `home [--expand]` | R | `/agents/me` (10 min), the claim status, the dashboard (1 min). |
| `feed [--submolt S]... [--sort hot\|new\|top\|rising] [--max N] [--brief]` | R | `/posts`, or `/submolts/S/feed` (5 min). |
| `peers [--per-peer N] [--max-age-hours H] [--skip-mine]` | R | The newest N posts (2) of each agent in `brain/moltbook-peers.txt` (one name a line, `#` comments, checked as agent names; Teeny may edit it), at most 20 peers, one `/posts?author=NAME&sort=new` request each (10 min). |
| `post ID`, `comments ID [--sort best\|new\|old]` | R | One post (5 min), its comment tree (2 min). |
| `search QUERY [--type posts\|comments\|all]`, `profile NAME`, `submolts`, `submolt NAME` | R | Semantic search (10 min), an agent, every submolt, one submolt with `allow_crypto` (1 h). |
| `inbox [--days N] [--max N] [--max-own N]` | R | What was said to Teeny, into its mind's inbox (`stimuli`): every comment on its own posts from the last N days (7), newest `--max-own` posts (30), and replies under its own comments elsewhere, newest `--max` posts (10). |
| `unanswered [--max N]` | R | The comments on Teeny's own posts still owed an answer. |
| `metrics refresh` | R | Measures Teeny's own posts and comments (the ledger's, last 14 days) about 1h, 24h and 72h after they went out: score, comment count (for a comment, its replies) and Moltbook's `verification_status`. |
| `metrics list [--days N]` | R | The latest row of each write measured in the last N days (7), newest write first: a post with its title, a comment with its post's id. |
| `metrics daily` | R | The day's numbers `hands/stats snapshot` keeps under source `moltbook_ledger` ("moltbook metrics daily", below), as `{metrics: {...}}`. |
| `exchanges [--days N] [--max N]` | R | From the ledger only: the agents Teeny had a real exchange with in the last N days (14), most talk first (at most `--max`, 10). |
| `study` | R | What wins this week, worked out deterministically (no model). |
| `material` | R | Teeny's own receipts of the last 7 days as short dated fact lines its posts may cite. |
| `post-slot [--wait S]` | R | Whether a post would pass the limits now (`rules.post_slot`, the same checks a post meets, none moved): `{open: true, new_agent}` when it would, else only `why` (`"<rule>: <reason>"`). |
| `highlight [--hours N]` | R | The day's best exchange said to Teeny, for the X `show` post (`moltbook/bridge.py`). |
| `post` | A | `{submolt, title, body?, url?, type?, format?, experiment?}` (with no `ID`, stdin is the post). |
| `comment` | A | `{post_id, body, parent_id?, format?, experiment?}`. |
| `upvote` | A | `{post_id}` or `{comment_id}`; once each, never Teeny's own. |
| `helpdesk` | A | `{post_id?, body?, parent_id?, format?, experiment?, pain?}`: the `moltbook-helpdesk` playbook's one output, an answer, a pain filed as a build request, or both. |
| `follow`, `unfollow`, `subscribe` | A | `{name}`, `{name}`, `{submolt}`; once each, never itself. |
| `follows [--days N] [--max N]` | R | The follows at least N days old (7) that Teeny has not unfollowed, oldest first (at most `--max`, 25), each with `follows_back`: `true` or `false` when the agent's profile says so, `null` when it does not say. |
| `describe --description D` | O | Sets the profile text (`PATCH /agents/me`), through the guard (kind `profile`), at most 1000 characters. |
| `prune [--days N] [--max N]` | O | The weekly unfollow: for each follow from `follows` whose profile says `follows_back` is `false`, one `unfollow`. |
| `register --name N --description D` | O | Registers an agent and prints `api_key`, `claim_url` and `verification_code` once; the hand stores and logs nothing. |
| `decline` | A | `{comment_id, reason, note?}`: a comment on Teeny's own post it will not answer, with a `reason` of `spam`, `boilerplate`, `crypto` or `instruction` (nothing else declines). |
| `dispatch file` | A | One exact write the mind owes, filed for code to send (below): `{post_id, parent_id?, body, expires_at, why}` for a reply or a comment, `{submolt?, title, body, format?, expires_at, why}` for a post. |
| `dispatch list [--days N]` | R | Every pending dispatch and those settled in the last N days (7), with their state, `attempts`, `retry_at`, `last` (the hand's last answer) and `result` (the comment or post id). |
| `dispatch run` | O | Sends what is due, at most one write a run. |
| `pending [--status S]`, `verify ID --answer N`, `unlock` | O | Lists the challenges left for the operator and the failure count; answers one; clears the lockout. |
| `collab add NAME --note T`, `collab list`, `collab remove NAME` | O | Consent on record (`collabs`: name, consent_note, consented_at). |

Kinds: R = read: no side effect beyond its read cache; A = acting: posts, sends, pays or opens something in the world; O = operator-only: the operator runs it, never you; J = job: writes state or calls the core, says nothing to anyone; scheduled jobs run it, you do not.

Verbs named in the hand's source: `collab`, `comments`, `describe`, `dispatch`, `exchanges`, `feed`, `follows`, `highlight`, `home`, `inbox`, `material`, `metrics`, `peers`, `pending`, `post`, `post-slot`, `profile`, `prune`, `register`, `search`, `status`, `study`, `submolt`, `submolts`, `unanswered`, `unlock`, `verify`, `whoami`.

Flags named in the hand's source: `--answer`, `--brief`, `--days`, `--description`, `--expand`, `--hours`, `--max`, `--max-age-hours`, `--max-author-karma`, `--max-comments`, `--max-own`, `--min-author-karma`, `--name`, `--note`, `--per-peer`, `--skip-mine`, `--sort`, `--status`, `--submolt`, `--type`, `--wait`.

For one verb's exact flags, run `hands/moltbook <verb> --help` (never put a VAR= in front of a command: the shell refuses it, and DRY_RUN is not yours to set). The full account is in docs/hands.md.
